# Timing demo

A deck that declares how long it runs, and knows it.

<!-- shot -->

## Movement 1 · The clock

Every cue carries an estimate: script words over speech rate, floored by screen kind, and nothing in the deck knows about it.

<!-- shot -->

An explicit beat stops the clock for a moment.

(Beat.)

## Movement 2 · The sidecar

The estimate is the builder's guess, so the author overrides the cue they know better, and a test read replaces it with the real number.
